title: Female inmates Capacity, Population & Occupancy rate duriny: 1999
pdf_title: Female inmates Capacity, Population & Occupancy rate duriny: 1999
notes: From the table, it is evident that against the available capacity for the female
inmates, occupancy rate of such prisoners during the period under consideration was very
high in the state of Haryana (716%) followed by Delhi (365.8%), Bihar (157.2%), Punjab
(153%) and Maharashtra (115.8%). In the remaining States/UTs, the female inmates
lodged in jails were less than capacity available for them.
